parameters.name: transferLineId
parameters.description: The planning context's transfer line id (`<transfer_id>:<line>`), the DB-unique key both the origin-side transfer_allocations ledger and the destination-side transfer_receipts row are anchored on (ADR 0031).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0018). Required whenever the service runs with Postgres — i.e. in every deployment — and answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response, while the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`. The in-memory development mode (no DATABASE_URL) does not enforce it, which is why the header is not marked `required` here (the Schemathesis contract run boots that mode).
